findings.title: Swedish stale-plan pill tooltip renders a literal {minuter} instead of the minute limit
findings.claim: Under hass.language sv, the card's stale-plan status pill title produced by statusPill() reads 'Ingen ny plan på mer än {minuter} min.' with the placeholder unsubstituted, because STRINGS.sv['status.stale_title'] names {minuter} while the call site passes {minutes}.
findings.mechanism: statusPill() calls L('status.stale_title', { minutes: Math.round(age.limit) }); L() substitutes only names present in vars and leaves any other {name} verbatim; the sv translation renamed the token to {minuter}. tests/card.mjs's R10-I18N-DE parity arm does refuse it when run here (FAIL 'sv: status.stale_title drops {minutes}; adds {minuter}', with HPO_PLANDATA from tests/plan_view.py), so the baseline carries a red card.mjs check; why it reached the baseline is a lead for the D3/D11 owner, not measured here.

findings.title: sv persistent heat-curve write budget text: '0 or 1 writes nothing', 'one always kept for the restore' are false
findings.claim: translations/sv.json options.step.heat_curve.data_description.heat_curve_persistent_writes_per_day says one write is always kept back for the off-restore and that a budget of 0 or 1 writes nothing, but production heat_curve._write_persistent_target sends 1 plan write a day at budget 1 and 12 at budget 12, so with the unbudgeted restore a day reaches budget+1 writes.
findings.mechanism: The refusal is `writes_today(state, now) + 1 > budget`, which admits the write that reaches the budget itself; nothing holds one back for off_restore's restore, which _persistent_restored then counts to the day. The text (and the module docstring's I2) state the stricter rule.

evidence.contention_note: shared finder box during fan-out; count is load-immune

perturbation.change: one-line production edit (applied in memory by --perturb): `writes_today(state, now) + 1 > budget` -> `writes_today(state, now) + 2 > budget`

findings.metric_definition: heat_curve._send calls made by _write_persistent_target in one local day with the plan asking a new target every 61 min (dwell 60), at budget B=1; key: the seam's send calls.
findings.phenomenon_property: For every budget B the persistent arm's plan writes in a local day are at most max(B-1, 0), so plan writes plus the off-restore never exceed B, and B in {0,1} sends nothing.
findings.seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D6/s4/persistent_budget.py   (RESULT over_text_B<n> for B in 0,1,2,12; every nonzero is a seam)

null_control.note: at budget 0 the arm sends nothing, as the text says; the excess is exactly one write at every B>=1 (B1:1, B2:2, B12:12)

reproduction_steps: harness -> plan_writes_B1=1, B2=2, B12=12; total_with_restore = B+1
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Either make heat_curve._write_persistent_target keep one write back (as the text and the module's I2 say), or correct the sentence in every language file and strings.json; the fixer decides which side is wrong, the property above holds the code to whichever text survives.
